test_title: SSC CGL Tier 2 English Previous Paper 1 (Held on: 8 Aug 2022)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate passive form of the given sentence.**

The flood victims of Assam have to make highway their home every year.

options.text: Highway has to be made their home every year by the flood victims of Assam.
Highway has been made their home every year by the flood victims of Assam.
Highway is being made their home every year by the flood victims of Assam.
Highway has made the flood victims of Assam their home every year.

solution:
The correct answer is **Highway has to be made their home every year by the flood victims of Assam**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Modal verb** 'have to' **is used in the given sentence.
